description: The platform-api contract files this repository builds against, copied byte for byte. The runner client in internal/runner/api is generated from openapi/runner.json (task generate:runner-client), and internal/runner/contract_test.go holds both this record and the client to the file. platform-api 24.0.0 published no release bundle (no release.json asset), so the copy is taken from the release tag and pinned here by digest. To move it: copy the file from the new tag, update version, tag, commit and sha256, then regenerate.
